title: A2A v1.0 message/task/part subset (vendored, internal-first)
description: Canonical Spellguard copy of the A2A (Agent2Agent) v1.0 protocol object model, trimmed to the message/task/part/artifact subset the Spellguard collaboration plane carries over the existing agent-control WebSocket. This is the single named source the TypeScript, Go, and Python mirrors are validated against.
$comment: PROVENANCE — Upstream: github.com/a2aproject/A2A, file specification/a2a.proto (proto package lf.a2a.v1), main @ af112d9491c1fd4b2a568ac65755af4a62790490 (fetched 2026-07-17). The upstream JSON-Schema build artifact (a2a.json / docs/spec/a2a.json) is NOT kept under version control — it is generated from a2a.proto via protoc + protoc-gen-jsonschema — so this schema is hand-derived from the canonical proto and trimmed to the carried subset. JSON field names follow the proto3 lowerCamelCase mapping (message_id -> messageId). Enum values use the A2A v1.0 SCREAMING_SNAKE representation with the proto value prefixes stripped (TASK_STATE_SUBMITTED -> SUBMITTED; ROLE_USER -> USER), per the v1.0 breaking-change facts. NO agent card, JSON-RPC/gRPC binding, or transport frame types are included (internal-first, shapes-only). `additionalProperties: false` closes each A2A object envelope for NEG-009; standard extension interiors (`data` and `metadata`) deliberately remain open and are not content-screened. Kept dependency-free at runtime — the plugins ship hand-rolled guards (validateA2aMessage / validateA2aTask); this file is the reference artifact the test-suite validates example payloads against.

A2aTaskState.title: A2aTaskState
A2aTaskState.description: The 8 standard A2A v1.0 task lifecycle states (proto TaskState minus TASK_STATE_UNSPECIFIED, value prefix stripped).

A2aRole.title: A2aRole
A2aRole.description: Sender role (proto Role minus ROLE_UNSPECIFIED, value prefix stripped).

A2aPart.title: A2aPart
A2aPart.description: Unified v1.0 Part model — a content oneof (exactly one of text/raw/url/data) plus optional metadata/filename/mediaType. NOTE: v1.0 removed the v0.3 `kind` discriminator; a `kind` field is therefore a rejected unknown property.

raw.description: File byte content, base64-encoded (proto bytes -> JSON base64 string).

data.description: Arbitrary structured data (proto google.protobuf.Value): object, array, string, number, boolean, or null.

A2aMessage.title: A2aMessage
A2aMessage.description: One unit of communication. Required: messageId, role, parts.

A2aArtifact.title: A2aArtifact
A2aArtifact.description: A task output. Required: artifactId, parts.

A2aTaskStatus.title: A2aTaskStatus
A2aTaskStatus.description: The status container of a task. Required: state.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 / RFC-3339 timestamp the status was recorded.

A2aTask.title: A2aTask
A2aTask.description: The core unit of action. Required: id, status.
